quiz.prompt: Corporal punishment of children in Germany is…

goodToKnow: Prügel, used as a plural, means a beating: Prügel bekommen, eine Tracht Prügel. In sport, it's a heavy defeat. Sich prügeln means to fight with fists, and die Prügelei is a brawl. Since 2000, German law gives children the right to a violence-free upbringing, banning all corporal punishment. Der Prügel (singular) is an old word for a cudgel.
